text:
We piloted an AI note-taker with a 12-person field sales team for one quarter. Here's what we learned.

**1. Reps got time back.** Post-call admin dropped from about 25 minutes to under 10. That time went to prep and follow-up.

**2. CRM data got better.** Notes were consistent, so managers finally saw patterns in objections and competitor mentions.

**3. Consent matters.** Some customers hesitated at first. A short, upfront explanation fixed most of it.

**4. Accuracy isn't perfect.** Product names and acronyms needed review. Reps who skimmed summaries caught errors early.

**5. Adoption followed coaching.** Teams that reviewed call insights together in weekly huddles stuck with it.

The tool didn't replace judgment. It freed up room for it.

What's your team learned from AI note-takers?
